_because: 2026-09-04: the corpus grew, so the counts fell. This checker asks 'does anything reach this?', and on 2026-09-04 the operator's apps moved into apps/, its own git repository, invisible to the platform's git ls-files. Five platform surfaces then read as dead having lost no caller at all: the app shell helpers and both chat docks (imported by app module.tsx through the @shell/ seam), services.app_persona (imported by three app personas), and the relay API area. The fix was to the SCAN, not to the pins -- nested-repo tracked files are in the corpus now, app Python imports count as imports, and reachability through @shell/ is followed transitively. Pinning those five as deliberately-dead would have been false and would have hidden them the next time they really did die. Net: frontend 4->1, backend 19->17, api areas 3->2.
